title: Failure Signature
description: Output contract for the investigation stage. Encodes a reusable behavioral failure pattern extracted from a confirmed historical case. Consumed by the analysis stage to guide static code inspection of a new target.

case_id.description: Stable identifier for this historical case, e.g. 'echocode-case-001-duplicate-operation'.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 date on which this signature was extracted (YYYY-MM-DD).

extraction_status.description: 'complete' means all evidence fields are populated and confirmed.

historical_bug_commit.description: Git SHA of the commit that first introduced the defect.

verification_commit.description: Git SHA of the commit where the behavioral regression test was added.

historical_fix_commit.description: Git SHA of the commit that applied the repair.

reported_behavior.description: Human description of the observable failure as reported or observed.

trigger.description: The specific action or sequence that triggers the failure.

required_conditions.description: Ordered list of structural conditions that must ALL be present for this failure class to apply. The analysis stage checks each condition against the target codebase.

observed_failure.description: Concrete evidence of the failure observed at runtime.

expected_invariant.description: The business invariant that this failure violates, stated precisely.

historical_repair_behavior.description: How the repair changed observable behavior, confirmed by real test runs.

reusable_failure_pattern.description: The generalised, technology-agnostic pattern extracted from this case for use in future analyses.

analogous_contexts.description: Domain variants where this pattern commonly recurs.

evidence.description: Supporting artefacts: source code excerpts, regression tests, test run outputs, fix diffs.

code_references.description: Short path:line-range references for quick navigation to key code locations.

confidence.description: 'high' requires a complete evidence chain: bug commit, regression test FAIL, fix commit, regression test PASS — all from real observed runs.

implementation_details_deliberately_excl.description: Technology-specific details intentionally omitted so the pattern stays general.
